_doc.what: Organisation roles and money flows for the world package (engine/orgs.py and engine/org_money.py read this; they hold no role words).
_doc.kinds: One entry per org_profiles.org_kind (the outfit shape). choices: the layer choices (outfit_choices registers them) men of this kind may weigh. opening: how engine/outfit_opening builds the kind at the opening (layout units or ranks; roles with ages, sex or male_share_key, level; unit_label, own_group_share, inducted_after_age, leader/member figures, in_roles, line_roles). head: the role of the organisation's top seat. unit_leader: the role that leads a unit (null: no units, a dead earner's line passes straight to the head). labels: role_key to the title used in the membership text ('<label> in the <org>'). courtship_scan: whether the household courtship scan may pair these members (false: the organisation is not a courtship pool). purse_roles and inducted_label are carried for later tasks.
_doc.orgs: Per-organisation additions keyed by org_profiles.package_key (the outfit key): 'rules' are appended to the kind's rules.
_doc.flows: Ordered flow names written to org_money.kind. The first is the inflow from outside (posted with ledger.receive); every other flow is a transfer between purses. ledger_kinds maps a flow to its ledger flow_kind; ledger_purpose is the ledger purpose text ({flow} is the flow name). arrangement_kinds: one entry per org_arrangements.kind, {flow, ledger_kind, purpose}: the flow its payments are written under in org_money (a name from flows), the ledger flow_kind and the ledger purpose text. An arrangement is a payer (an organisation or a person) paying an official weekly_usd a week, through a go-between when there is one; engine/org_money.post_arrangements posts them after the stages below. An organisation payer pays from the holders of its kind's purse_roles in proportion to the take of the men under each posted that period (the head when the kind has no purse_roles or no take); a person pays from his own purse; a dead payer lapses the arrangement.
_doc.rules: Per-kind lists applied in order. Each rule has a type, a flow, a stage (int; transfers are applied stage by stage, so a man holds what he passes on) and roles. A share is {figure, default}: a design figure key and the value used when the package has no such figure. Types: paid_by_patron (members in roles are paid out of the take of the man they work under, i.e. the earner of their superior: living = a yearly sum (the person's net of the return share), cap = the largest share of the patron's take paid out, reliability spreads the pay, return_share goes straight back to the patron as the return_flow); to_superior (members in roles who earn pass a share of net take to the earner over them); regime_to_head (members in roles pass a share of their own net take plus what to_superior sent them to the head); head_share (the head's receipts from to_superior and regime_to_head are shared out to members in roles); to_head_pick (every earner outside the head role passes share of take to a head chosen by a stable hash, tag); to_head_via_superior (as to_head_pick but to the earner's superior when he holds the head role; the earner keeps 'keep' of it); to_first_head (every earner outside the head role passes share of take to the first head).
